title: CSIR Notification 2026 - Apply Online for Various Project Associate I Posts
description: National Environmental Engineering Research Institute (CSIR NEERI) has issued the official notification for the recruitment of 01 Project Associate I. Candidates who have passed 10th or ITI can grab this chance and apply for the CSIR NEERI Notification 2026 . Here we have included the age limit, selection process, salary structure, education details, application fee, and how to apply for these posts. If you are looking for more, here is a list of Government Jobs that you can all apply for. Us...
